metadata.scenario: A potential customer calls to inquire about the features of a new product before deciding to purchase. Category: General Information. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Dorothy Henderson. I wanted to inquire about the services you offer. Of course, Dorothy! What specific services are you interested in? I’m particularly curious about your physical therapy and personal care assistance. Great choices! Our physical therapy is priced between $110 to $140 for a session lasting 45 to 60 minutes. That sounds reasonable. Can you tell me what the sessions typically involve? Sure! The sessions include mobility training, strength improvement, and balance exercises tailored to your needs. That sounds perfect for my recovery. And what about personal care assistance? Personal care assistance is $28 to $35 per hour, focusing on bathing, grooming, and daily hygiene support. I see. Do you have female caregivers available? Yes, we can accommodate requests for female caregivers. That's great to hear. How do I go about scheduling these services? You can schedule a visit by speaking with our Care Coordinator, Lisa Chen, at extension 203. Perfect. I’ll call her later. Do you also offer services for post-surgery recovery? Yes, we do! Our post-surgery recovery care is $85 to $110 for 1 to 3 hours. That sounds useful. Is the care provided daily or as needed? It can be customized based on your recovery needs, either scheduled daily or as required. Wonderful! I’m still considering the right option. Can I get a brochure or some written information? Absolutely! I can email you our service brochure outlining all options and pricing. What’s your email address? It's dorothy.henderson@email.com. Got it! I’ll send that right away. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate your help today. My pleasure, Dorothy! Is there anything else I can help you with? No, that covers everything for now. Great! Just a reminder to reach out to Lisa for scheduling, and I’ll send that email shortly. Will do! Have a great day! You too, Dorothy! Take care!
